facts.fact: CIPESA states Rwanda was the first African country to adopt a national AI policy, in 2019.

CIPESA states Rwanda's AI policy mandates the Responsible AI office under the Ministry of ICT and Innovation to implement it, with RURA as technical regulator and NCSA overseeing data protection; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

note: Rwanda's project-level funding framework is stated without any allocation, so no funded fact.
